title: NRC field retrofit W2 — R-10 exterior XPS on a 2x6 wood-frame wall
jurisdiction: NRC Field Exposure of Walls facility, Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (field research; no permit jurisdiction)
code_edition: Unknown; no project code edition is stated.

facts.text: The field study compared three nominally identical 1,727 x 1,219 mm (5 ft 8 in x 4 ft) wood-frame walls with R-20 cavity insulation; two received R-10 exterior retrofits.
W2 was one of three 2x6, R-20 wood-frame walls at NRC’s Ottawa Field Exposure of Walls facility; its retrofit was RSI 1.76 (R-10) XPS exterior insulation.
The report describes RH/temperature sensors, liquid-detection tape, a chamber held near 21°C and deliberate 3 mm slit in the interior air/vapour layer for one exposure protocol.

limitations: Research specimens and exposure conditions do not establish behavior of a building outside this study.
